content: All fixture URLs, titles, tags and descriptions are new synthetic examples created for Covelet. No third-party export content or code is redistributed.

raindrop.format: Observed historical Netscape HTML structure with A[TAGS] and A[DESCRIPTION] attributes
raindrop.clientVersion: unknown; not encoded in the public export
raindrop.scope: Title, URL, folder, comma-delimited tags and DESCRIPTION attribute. DD highlights, DATA-COVER, uploaded files and user-note fields are not imported or claimed. The public artifact has no explicit reuse license and is not copied into this fixture.

onetab.scope: Own records passed through the inspected official plain URL/title serializer. URL/title join is space-pipe-space, link separator is newline, group separator is a blank line. Not an end-to-end browser export. The official package has a custom license and is not redistributed. Text contains no client version marker; compatibility does not identify a picked file's exporter. Rich text, labels, notes, named groups and other versions are not claimed.
